previousRule: Shopping Cart required a delivery postcode and specification checkbox before a customer could continue to Shopify. Delivery could show Awaiting confirmation despite an approved standard UK charge, and the ordinary cart could show Ordering is not yet enabled for this review. Northern Ireland and Highland standard rates were higher than the owner's new UK-wide instruction.
newRule: Valid curtains, Roman blinds, smart tracks and cushions receive an immediate reviewed total with one approved £12.95 standard delivery charge for UK destinations, without a cart postcode or checkbox. One Order now action opens Shopify's address and payment steps. Genuine product and specialist delivery gates remain. Sample credit and eligible personal 10% codes remain available in expandable sections, with guest checkout available without a personal code. The mobile order action stays visible without obscuring the cart, and the production MAIN theme manifest records the two changed assets.
reason: The owner found that the extra cart steps and ordering-disabled wording confused customers. The owner explicitly set £12.95 for every UK address and asked for an immediate, accessible, one-click path from a valid quote to checkout. The existing cart price and Shopify draft delivery must stay consistent across regions.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner directed this urgent cart simplification and UK-wide £12.95 standard delivery in chat. Repository policy still requires a separate exact-head Nylon1 approval comment on the production release PR before merge; this record does not substitute for that comment.
